title_zh: 转行前先了解入门课程

scenario.goal_zh: 讨论转行念头并确定低风险了解行业的下一步。

context_zh: 一位想转入数据工作的成年人向朋友讨论学习路线，决定先了解课程内容和实际岗位。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Sonia
sentences.text: My ambition is to move into data analysis, but I do not have many academic qualifications.

sentences.speaker: Adrian
sentences.text: You do have years of experience keeping the shop's records. That is worth discussing with a course adviser.

sentences.speaker: Sonia
sentences.text: I found an advanced course that promises to cover everything in six weeks.

sentences.speaker: Adrian
sentences.text: That sounds ambitious. Have you looked at the entry requirements?

sentences.speaker: Sonia
sentences.text: Not yet. What would you advise me to do first?

sentences.speaker: Adrian
sentences.text: Read the beginner course outline, and talk to someone who does the job before you pay for anything.

sentences.speaker: Sonia
sentences.text: My cousin works in that field. I will ask her about a normal working day and look at the beginner course tonight.

sentences.speaker: Adrian
sentences.text: Good. Then you can decide whether the subject actually interests you.

targets.sense_zh: 计划要求很高的；雄心勃勃的
